paper_title: Searching for Low-Mass Axions using Resonant Upconversion
notes: Room temperature resonant upconversion haloscope (UPLOAD, power technique). Excludes axions of mass 1.12-1.20 ueV (271.7-290.3 MHz) above coupling strength 3e-6 1/GeV for both g_agamma and g_aBB. Values taken from abstract/text; exclusion is approximately flat at 3e-6 GeV^-1 over the mass range (Fig. 7).
